sources.entry: Cozy Cloud - Personal cloud where you can manage and sync your files, notes, contacts, passwords, and documents. (Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Cozy Store is the marketplace web app for installing and managing apps inside a Cozy personal cloud.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Cozy Store as the marketplace application used to manage apps in a Cozy instance. Cozy is described as a platform that brings web services into one private space that users can host on their own hardware. The README covers developer setup: cloning the repository, installing dependencies with Yarn, and running a watch server for development. It also explains running the app in a browser through the cozy-stack Docker image, linking the cozy-ui library locally for development, and running the mocha/chai/sinon test suite. A section describes how apps should use Cozy's standard doctypes (data models such as Bills, Contacts, Files) or define their own. Translations are managed through Transifex.
use_cases: install apps into a self-hosted Cozy personal cloud
develop or modify the Cozy Store marketplace app
contribute translations to Cozy apps via Transifex
learn how Cozy apps use standard doctypes
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL> (URL is blank in the README)
notable: Acts as the app marketplace for a Cozy personal cloud rather than a standalone service
Uses the shared cozy-ui component library so it matches other Cozy apps
Translations are pulled from Transifex during the build
Includes a Docker-based option for running the app inside a Cozy stack VM
caveats: Mainly a developer-facing repository: it assumes a running Cozy instance and a Cozy dev environment
Several links in the README are empty, so setup depends on external Cozy developer documentation
